content.text: The redline validated. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: (i) All paragraph headings contained in this Agreement are for convenience only and shall not affect the interpretation of this Agreement.
input.rationale: A full-text search for "insurance" returns no results, and General Matters (§ 20, subsections (a)–(i) at p0135–p0147) contains no insurance covenant, so no usable clause exists anywhere in the Agreement. The rule is triggered because Garman is not a pure software licensor: it installs the Software on AS400s at each Authorized Location and performs future installations at Sparkling's sites (p0041, p0042), and it converts "Sparkling's data ... from its current electronic form" (p0042), plus training and ongoing maintenance. A vendor that both works on our premises and processes our data with no insurance at all sits in walk-away territory under this rule, well short of even the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M). We therefore insert a short preferred-position insurance paragraph as new § 20(j), the smallest edit that cures the gap, drafted with "Sparkling's data" rather than "Customer Data" since that term is not defined in this Agreement, and noting the fallback limits in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert vendor insurance covenant as new General Matters subsection (j)
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We added a standard insurance covenant, as our playbook requires coverage from vendors whose personnel attend our locations and who handle our data during installation, conversion and support. If the cyber limit is an issue we can discuss E&O of USD 1,000,000 and cyber of USD 2,000,000 as a fallback.

ops.text: (j) Garman shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; where Garman processes, stores or has access to Sparkling's data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000; and workers' compensation insurance as required by applicable law. Garman shall provide certificates of insurance to Sparkling on request.
